title: VerbalWorkingMemory
description: Raw EEG recorded during a modified Sternberg verbal working memory task. Participants either simply retained letters or mentally manipulated them by alphabetization, at three memory loads of 5, 6, or 7 letters. Event markers label the baseline, encoding, delay, probe, and response periods for each task and load condition.
methods_description: Modified Sternberg working memory paradigm with two task types (retention vs. manipulation/alphabetization) and three load levels (5, 6, 7 letters). Events.tsv files in the eeg folders code trial phases: baseline, instruction, encoding, delay, probe, and response (correct/error).
